data.narrative:
Helios is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $26M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 9 comparable companies in the Climate & Energy sector—1 public (Linanza: LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting narrow filtering criteria; the 8 sector peers lack sufficient clustering by stage and valuation tier to support reliable cross-sectional inference. Instead, stage-progression methodology was applied, using the $26M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage transitions, yielding an implied valuation of $52M.

The triangulated range is $44M (low) to $60M (high), with a median point estimate of $52M. This analysis reflects material sensitivity to stage-specific growth assumptions; the 2.0x multiplier embeds an assumption of moderate dilution and capital efficiency between Series A and later rounds. Key uncertainties include the appropriate denominator for peer comparison (the 8 peers span multiple energy subsectors and funding stages) and whether $26M in total raised appropriately proxies current post-money valuation absent explicit data on prior round prices and dilution.
